apps.subtitle: YouTube Music and YouTube, without ads.
apps.localizedDescription:
Koda plays music from YouTube Music and videos from YouTube, without ads. Use it with no account at all, or sign in to bring your likes, playlists, subscriptions and history with you.

Synced lyrics with translation, AutoMix and crossfade, an equalizer, downloads, animated album art, widgets, Siri and Shortcuts, Last.fm scrobbling, profiles, and a Video mode with picture in picture.

The Apple sibling of Koda for Android, written in SwiftUI with Liquid Glass.
